Visual representation of the target-pathway network

Visual representation of the target-pathway network. Nodes represent target genes and KEGG pathways, with edges indicating gene–pathway associations. Elliptical nodes represent pathways, while rectangular nodes represent target genes. A color scale from light yellow to orange reflects increasing pathway relevance
